proposals.evidence: The śodhana article and addendum give Western Pahari Kotgarhi śv̄̃ṇ and Kiunthali śū̃hṇ “broom”, beside Jaunsari śuain and Hindi sonī. Kullui śun belongs to this geographically and semantically specific contracted broom family; source absence of nasal-vowel and aspiration marking is retained.
